question: Ustad Allauddin Khan, the legendary sarod player, was from which of the following gharanas of music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maihar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In Ustad Allauddin Khan__ honor, a Sangeet Samaroh is organized annually in Maihar, Satna
 
• It is organized by the Ustad Allauddin Khan Sangeet Academy in collaboration with the Madhya Pradesh Sanskriti Parishad.
 
• Allauddin Khan Sangeet Samaroh of Maihar is a three-day festival.
 
• Allauddin Khan totally reshaped Indian classical music's Maihar Gharana. 
 
• Allauddin Khan was also known as Baba Allauddin Khan.
 
• He was an Indian sarod player.
